_comment_1: MERGE the mcpServers key below into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — do NOT replace that file, it already contains coworkUserFilesPath and preferences.
_comment_2: command MUST be the absolute path to node. Claude Desktop launches from Finder without your shell profile, so nvm's node is not on its PATH and a bare 'node' fails silently.
_comment_3: No secret belongs in this file. OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY is deliberately absent — the server loads the gitignored project env file by absolute path. HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID is a public account id, included only to skip a rate-limited mirror node lookup.
